items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Percy Walker, he was the drummer for the Bronson band... And we had Herb Hanners on banjo. Percy Walker played drums.

ctx.x: So this was in 1928. Was Lester still listening to records a lot?
Oh yeah. He listened to them then, too. See, the reason why we moved... Percy Walker, he was the drummer for the Bronson band.
Actually, we didn't get all the members I don't think.
